units.title: SG-5.3.1 · Scene start plays the authored fade transition
Verify: playSceneTransition unit tests with a mocked context

tests.id: game/tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts::plays the authored fade with the content duration
tests.name: plays the authored fade with the content duration
tests.title: plays the authored fade with the content duration
tests.scenario: Given a fake context and a scene with a 400ms fade transition, When playSceneTransition runs, Then playTransition is called once with 400
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: game/tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts::does not play when the scene has no transition entry
tests.name: does not play when the scene has no transition entry
tests.title: does not play when the scene has no transition entry
tests.scenario: Given a fake context, When playSceneTransition runs against a scene with only an ambientLight effect and against a scene with no effects key, Then playTransition is never called
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: BootScene plays the authored transition on create

tests.name: builds the scene effects from the bundled bedroom scene when create() runs
tests.title: BootScene effects builds the scene effects from the bundled bedroom scene when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given a state in the store and buildEffects mocked, When create() runs, Then buildEffects is called once with the context and scene

tests.name: destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: BootScene effects destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given buildEffects returns two handles, When the SHUTDOWN callback runs, Then each handle is destroyed once

tests.name: plays the authored transition when create() runs
tests.title: BootScene effects plays the authored transition when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given a state in the store and buildEffects mocked to return [], When create() runs, Then playSceneTransition is called once with a context exposing playTransition and the bedroom scene

tests.name: playTransition(400) starts the main camera fade-in for 400 ms
tests.title: playTransition: fade-in and ambient layer on the Phaser scene starts the main camera fade-in for 400 ms
tests.scenario: Given a fake Phaser scene with a main camera, When playTransition(400) is called, Then cameras.main.fadeIn is called with 400

tests.name: createEffect for ambientLight adds a full-scene rectangle with the authored depth
tests.title: playTransition: fade-in and ambient layer on the Phaser scene adds a full-scene rectangle with the authored depth for ambientLight
tests.scenario: Given a fake Phaser scene, When createEffect is called for an ambientLight effect, Then a full-scene rectangle is added with the authored color, alpha and depth
